# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1997

**Appropriation Ordinance for Closing Special Budget**

## Summary

This ordinance adapts the closing special budget of the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It appropriates funds from total savings amounting to Two Million, Fifty-Four Thousand, Nine Hundred Eighty-Six Pesos and Seventy-Two Centavos (₱2,054,986.72), specifically appropriating Two Hundred Forty-One Thousand, Five Hundred Eighty-One Pesos and Seventy-Five Centavos (₱241,581.75) to cover the overdraft in appropriation. The ordinance takes effect immediately.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** From the total savings amounting to Two Million, Fifty-Four Thousand, Nine Hundred Eighty-Six Pesos and Seventy-Two Centavos (₱2,054,986.72), the amount of Two Hundred Forty-One Thousand, Five Hundred Eighty-One Pesos and Seventy-Five Centavos (₱241,581.75) is hereby appropriated to cover the overdraft in appropriation.
2.  **Section 2.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately.
